infobox.usage: Unlocks a cabin at the water treatment plant on Lighthouse.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Rogue USEC stash key (Stash) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the stash, located somewhere at the Rogue USEC base.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: This key opens a cabin that is located in the west of the water treatment plant on Lighthouse

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 1x Weapon box (6x2)
- 1x Weapon box (4x4)
- 1x Weapon box (6x6)
- Weapon mods
- Loose loot
